issues.description: The solution SQL for Aufgabe 05 uses a logically impossible condition (Gemeinde.regierungsbezirk = 'Oberbayern' AND Gemeinde.regierungsbezirk = 'Niederbayern'), which contradicts the problem statement that requests Gemeinden in Oberbayern OR Niederbayern. This makes the provided solution incorrect and will confuse students comparing their queries against the reference solution or tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the WHERE clause in aufgabe05.sql to use OR instead of AND for the regierungsbezirk condition: AND (Gemeinde.regierungsbezirk = 'Oberbayern' OR Gemeinde.regierungsbezirk = 'Niederbayern'). This will align the solution with the problem statement.
